latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Harden webhook delivery against non-HTTP hosts by @kmc-agent in https://github.com/basecamp/fizzy/pull/3306


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/basecamp/fizzy/compare/fizzy@65d432e...fizzy@b08e794

hot_issues.title: Enter # or ## or ### then space and you are locked and can't type
Selected users are buried in alphabetical order in filter dropdowns
Board drag-and-drop: "Drag cards here" drop zones don't collapse after dragging a card (Chrome on Windows)
MariaDB JSON columns cause ActiveRecord::ConfigurationError with store_accessor (filters.fields)
Is it possible to add a lock feature to prevent task edits after assignment, as well as an audit trail to log all changes made to tasks?
Incomplete card title when a new card is saved with Cmd+Enter keyboard shortcut
Feature request: Bot / service account support for API integrations
Add MCP HTTP endpoint with intelligent LLM-powered tools

discussions.title: "Me" shortcut in the Assigned to / Added by / Closed by filters
Keep a board's columns when filtering it
Mobile apps (iOS and Android): connect to a self-hosted Fizzy server
A (relatively) simple way to track projects across boards
UI render glitching when expand column on fizzy
Add support for single sign-on (SSO) through OIDC (implemented)
Marking all notifications as read from the tray shows "Content missing" and later GETs bulk_reading (404)
Feature Request: Be able to set and unset multiple tags at once

# Fizzy

This is the source code of [Fizzy](https://fizzy.do/), the Kanban tracking tool for issues and ideas by [37signals](https://37signals.com).


## Running your own Fizzy instance

The easiest way to self-host Fizzy is with [ONCE](https://github.com/basecamp/once).
It will guide you through the initial setup, and keep your instance up to date automatically. It has everything you need for a fully-functional, single-machine deployment.

To get started, run this on the machine where you want to install Fizzy:

```sh
curl https://get.once.com/fizzy | sh
```

### Deploying with Docker

If you'd rather run our pre-built Docker image yourself, you can find the details in our [Docker deployment guide](docs/docker-deployment.md).

### Deploying with Kamal

If you want more flexibility to customize your Fizzy installation by changing its code, and deploy those changes to your server, then we recommend you deploy Fizzy with Kamal. You can find a complete walkthrough of doing that in our [Kamal deployment guide](docs/kamal-deployment.md).


## Development

You are welcome -- and encouraged -- to modify Fizzy to your liking.
Please see our [Development guide](docs/development.md) for how to get Fizzy set up for local development.


## Contributing

We welcome contributions! Please read our [style guide](STYLE.md) before submitting code.
